definitions.explanation: The act of turning around a central point or axis.
The rate at which inventory or capital cycles through a business.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}は24{時間|じかん}で1{回転|かいてん}する。
examples.english: The Earth completes one rotation in 24 hours.

examples.japanese: {回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}で{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant.
examples.notes: {回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし} = conveyor belt sushi

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{客|きゃく}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}い。
examples.english: This shop has a fast customer turnover.

notes:
{回転|かいてん} describes circular motion or cyclical processes.

Common expressions:
- {回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし} (conveyor belt sushi)
- {回転|かいてん}{率|りつ} (turnover rate)
- {回転|かいてん}{椅子|いす} (swivel chair)
- {高速|こうそく}{回転|かいてん} (high-speed rotation)
- {頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}い (quick-witted, literally 'fast mental rotation')

Related terms:
- {自転|じてん} (rotation on own axis)
- {公転|こうてん} (revolution around another object)
- スピン (spin - loanword)
